# Australia PR Points Calculator

> Free, zero-latency Australian General Skilled Migration (GSM) points calculator and visa eligibility resource for Subclass 189, Subclass 190, and Subclass 491 visas.

AusPR Calculator (https://ausprcalculator.com) helps skilled professionals, international graduates, and prospective migrants evaluate their points test score under Schedule 6D of the Migration Regulations 1994 (Cth) administered by the Australian Department of Home Affairs.

## Core Calculators & Tools

- [All-in-One Australia PR Points Calculator](https://ausprcalculator.com/): Comprehensive interactive calculator comparing Subclass 189, Subclass 190, and Subclass 491 points simultaneously across age, English proficiency, employment history, education, partner qualifications, and bonus options.
- [Subclass 189 Points Calculator](https://ausprcalculator.com/subclass-189): Dedicated estimator and guide for the Skilled Independent (Subclass 189) permanent resident visa, including MLTSSL requirements and invitation cutoff benchmarks.
- [Subclass 190 Points Calculator](https://ausprcalculator.com/subclass-190): Dedicated estimator and guide for the Skilled Nominated (Subclass 190) permanent resident visa with automatic +5 state nomination bonus points and state-by-state nomination criteria (NSW, VIC, WA, SA, TAS, QLD, ACT, NT).
- [Subclass 491 Points Calculator](https://ausprcalculator.com/subclass-491): Dedicated estimator and guide for the Skilled Work Regional (Subclass 491) provisional visa with automatic +15 regional sponsorship bonus points, Category 2 & 3 regional area breakdowns, and transition requirements for the Subclass 191 PR pathway.

## Key Migration Points Rules (Schedule 6D Summary)

- **Pass Mark:** Minimum 65 points required to lodge a SkillSelect Expression of Interest (EOI).
- **Age Limit:** Must be under 45 years at time of invitation. Top points: 25–32 years (30 pts), 18–24 & 33–39 years (25 pts), 40–44 years (15 pts).
- **English Proficiency:** Competent (IELTS 6.0 / PTE 50 / CELPIP 7) = 0 pts; Proficient (IELTS 7.0 / PTE 65 / CELPIP 8) = 10 pts; Superior (IELTS 8.0 / PTE 79 / CELPIP 9) = 20 pts.
- **Work Experience Cap:** Combined maximum of 20 points across Australian and overseas skilled employment.
- **Education:** Doctorate / PhD (20 pts), Bachelor or Master's degree (15 pts), Trade / Diploma (10 pts).
- **Partner Skills:** Single or partner is AU citizen/PR (10 pts), Partner skilled under 45 with Competent English (10 pts), Partner Competent English only (5 pts).
- **State Nomination:** Subclass 190 grants an automatic +5 points.
- **Regional Sponsorship:** Subclass 491 grants an automatic +15 points.
